post-receive edits replace the actual body/status and automatic extraction reads processed metadata
response header/body views, native clipboard copy and downloaded JSON use the processed response
a saved script edits an already-received response through response/minipost.response without another HTTP request
a failing response script commits neither edited display/status nor variable/shared-data writes
Stop after pending mutations preserves the previous response and discards partial script writes
setBody/content type/show select the transformed HTML preview and matching download
processed response, HTML preview and response actions remain usable at desktop, 390 px and 320 px
restore returns to the first wire response after multiple transformations without resending
repeating show after manual view selection applies the new presentation once without modifying response bytes
delayed response processing and variable-only scripts cannot commit after a newer HTTP response
relation decisions and recorded status use the transformed response, skipping the unmatched request
a failed automatic post-hook preserves the received body/status and reports its error without partial writes
cancelling an automatic post-hook after mutation never commits its response or shared-data writes
automatic form-data row reordering sends the corresponding selected bytes while preserving editor selections
manually applying a form-data script moves live file selections with their rows and preserves receiver hashes
native response editing produces no uncaught JavaScript errors, browser dialogs or crashes
